regions.today: Scattered heavy showers clearing eastwards this evening. Risk of isolated thunderstorms. Moderate westerly winds.
regions.tonight: Mainly dry at first tonight with just isolated showers. Cloud will increase overnight, bringing some light rain later in the night to the northern half of Leinster. Lowest temperatures of 11 to 14 degrees with moderate to fresh westerly winds.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will be a rather windy day and feeling fresher than recently with a mix of sunny spells and showers. Highest temperatures of 17 to 19 degrees in fresh and gusty westerly winds.
